notes:
2026-09-24
 Battery and background
- Background wake-ups no longer reschedule every job. The app cold-starts in the background many times a day (motion alarm, activity broadcasts, jobs); each start used to re-enqueue all periodic work, add a battery job and push back the walk-confirmation alarm. Now it only fills in what is missing, and refreshes schedules once per app version.
- Fixed a Play Services leak that could keep 30-second activity samples running after the app process died.
- Activity-transition registration happens at most once per process / 6 hours instead of on every motion tick.
- Idle ticks reuse a step-counter read from the last 3 s instead of holding the CPU awake 1.2 s for a second read.
